continuous_bounds.limits: Continuous bounds cover ideal tapered panel and straight X-axis pitch path. Detailed hinge/lock parts and floor/ramp contact use discrete OCCT checks; no whole-motion continuous collision proof.

robot_path.method: Rigid contact candidate from actual lower track triangles (0.05 mm tessellation), minimum origin height for pitch in [0,ramp angle]; 0.05 mm contact tolerance lift. Exact OCCT solid-common checks at <=2 mm Y spacing; reversing samples represents reverse entry.
robot_path.limits: Not continuous collision proof, real rolling/track deformation, mass stability, friction, dynamic loads, steering, flexible hose motion, or physical acceptance.

reuse_after_fix.proof: New door panel is a subset of previously checked obstacle. All 272 path poses remain collision-free; no support surface was removed (inner face retained outside central hinge bore).
